notes: Full text read at https://arxiv.org/html/2603.27195 . Section 4 Baselines explicitly states that NSGA-II optimizes conditioning parameters passed to the learned MIND generator and all baselines share that generator. Appendix B.2 confirms the numerical methods search its learned latent/conditioning space. Section 2 mentions classical topology and inverse-homogenization optimization only as background, without running, timing or citing a result from either as a comparator. The apparent traditional algorithm comparisons in Table 1 are therefore hybrid ML-pipeline comparisons, not classical topology or homogenization-based optimization comparisons.
